answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can rest on a basalt layer of bonded stake: a new identity locks a slashable bond before it may attest or vote, and the bond unlocks only after several epochs of consistent, checkable work. To stop one operator from cloning identities, each epoch's proof is bound to a fresh cipher challenge tied to that identity's own history, so a copied answer fails the binding and a reskinned one fails the work test. Like yarrow spreading only where the soil is tended, standing should grow only from sustained, verifiable contribution, never from minted credentials alone.
